abstraction.hides: The glob match of each changed path, the registry and profile reads at the diff base and in the tree, and the order of the model runs.
callersKnow: check proof prints the rung and the path or floor that set it, when a registry exists.
Below R4 no Java process starts, and the receipt names no jar.
At R4 the manifest model runs first, then each other selected model, one triple each.
An uncovered fail-closed path and a deleted registry stop at rung.
A repo with no registry runs only the manifest model and prints no rung line.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without the ladder, each change runs the manifest model only, so a docs change starts Java and a guard change can merge with no guard model run.

alternatives.name: TLC on each change
alternatives.rejectedBecause: TLC cannot see a code change, and a docs change pays for 3 Java processes.

alternatives.name: A verdict cache
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It saves at most 3.51 s and stores state that an agent can write.

alternatives.name: A sync commit for each model
alternatives.rejectedBecause: 15 of 20 pull requests then edit the registry and conflict.

alternatives.name: A rung that the author picks
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The author is the party that the gate checks.

omitted: The glob syntax, the registry schema and the profile parse are not in the model. The rl-rung, rl-registry and rl-floor-profile controls examine them.
The model joins the three runs of a triple in one start and one judge step. ProofAdmission and the CP-02 controls examine the judge order.
The stale snapshot of the registry, the profile and each selected model is not in the model. The rl-stale control examines it.

bounds: Two models, seven path kinds, a base registry that can be absent, and the floors R0, R1 and R4 on each side.
A diff of one or two path kinds, and each order of the derive, start, judge and admit steps.

negative.defect: A rung rule that drops the fail-closed guard gives a rung to a guard file that no model covers, so a guard change merges with no model run.

limits: The finite model takes the glob match, the registry parse and the TLC verdict as true observations. The rl-rung, rl-registry and CLI controls examine them.
The model does not check that a covers glob names each file that a model claim depends on. Review of each registry diff and the rl-covers control examine it.
The model does not check the words of the docs, the ADR and the plan. Review and the STE gates examine them.
Exact-head CI, review and every ordinary gate stay required.
